description: One page of a wallet's swaps, newest first (REST history, 7 days; not a live tail). `mints` keeps trades with any of those tokens on either side (quote assets SOL/USDC/USDT rejected there — use `solOnly: true` for SOL pairs). Filter venues with `source` (one) or `sources` (array), not both; `minVolumeUsd` / `maxVolumeUsd` bound the USD size. Each side carries `symbol` (null until resolved; key on mint); a routed swap is one row per hop with the same signature. Unknown wallet → empty list. To page, pass `cursor` = previous `next`; stop when `next` is null.

cursor.description: Pass the previous response's `next` for the next page

from.description: Unix ms or ISO-8601 start bound

limit.description: Rows per page; default 20 to conserve context — raise only if needed

mints.description: Tokens to keep (either side), up to 100

solOnly.description: When true, keep only SOL-paired swaps

sources.description: Several sources, e.g. ["pump_fun", "pump_amm"] (OR). Do not combine with `source`.

to.description: Unix ms or ISO-8601 end bound

name: list_wallet_trades
